usage_notes: Artifact IDs are Hugging Face weight identifiers, NOT API model IDs or proof of live serving availability.
'open weights' does not imply OSI-open-source license; verify each artifact's own license including derivatives and base-model requirements.
Publisher collection/page is evidence for model identity only; prices, context, tool ability, output quality and hardware fitness deliberately unknown unless independently sourced.
Do not assume BF16/FP8 753B models fit single 80GB H100; require weights, quantization, KV and throughput data.
One-model-one-entry keeps FP8/GGUF variants distinct; derived weights do not inherit base model benchmark scores.
Curated official-first discovery slice, not a claim to have enumerated every model published worldwide.
